scenes: Will an action against heat actually work here?

Every action on this page answers eight questions: | what to do, who it protects, where it suits, and who must act; | what it takes to run, the evidence, what could stop it, and what it only works with.
The last one matters most. | Water points need water. Rest breaks need pay.
